The '''gnooroop''' was a [[Fish/Legends|fish]] that lived within the seas of [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]], a completely [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TG">"[[Traitor's Gambit]]"</ref> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Gnooroop traveled together in extremely dense schools that could reach up to 10 [[Meter/Legends|kilometers]] long,<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> and were often hunted by Aquaris' menacing [[demonsquid]].<ref name="mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> Gnooroop [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] were noted for being especially slippery.<ref name="fh3">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gnooroop first appeared in ''[[Traitor's Gambit]]'', a [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] story arc written by [[Archie Goodwin]], illustrated by [[Al Williamson]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="TG" /> Although they went unidentified in ''Traitor's Gambit'', they were finally named in the [[1998]] ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> Gnooroop were also mentioned in the [[2003]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]'', where their name was misspelled "nooroop."<ref name="fh3" />
